question: Under what condition of examination may one grant long life to a recipient?
premises: The recipient must be thoroughly examined
Examination should be done always or carefully
Only then may long life be given
inference: After thorough examination, one may give long life to such a person.
uncertainties: The object cirajīvitam may be metaphorical rather than literal.
plain_english: Having always examined him well, one should give him long life.
